What exact process runs when every browser tab is closed?

Can two instances of MIA submit the same job at the same time?
Which state is persisted before, during and after each order transition?
Does /api/health mean server alive, or does it prove the bot scheduler is operating?
What happens if 100 workers share one corrupt market snapshot?
Does a WebSocket reconnection restore sequence integrity, or just reconnect the socket?
Are charts re-rendering more frequently than the user can perceive?
What p95 latency matters most: screen interaction, ingest, consensus or risk-to-paper execution?
What evidence is needed to prove a 24-hour paper-only soak succeeded?
Can every PnL number be recomputed from immutable fills and fees?
Can a pending funding transfer accidentally appear as trading profit?
What happens to an open paper position when no fresh executable order book exists?
Does a NO-TRADE signal have equal visibility to a trade signal?
Are model scores honestly marked as uncalibrated when outcome data are insufficient?
Can a strategy that lost out of sample be silently promoted by AI?
Which rules can stop a trade even when 100 workers agree?
Is every simulated Decision Twin result isolated from the real paper ledger?

Does a fake news headline ever change execution permissions?
Is any trading credential able to withdraw funds?
How does MIA prove a wallet balance is verified instead of simulated?
Can a copied/new withdrawal destination bypass multi-factor authorization?
Who can sign a transaction and what is the maximum authorization scope?
Are credentials exposed in browser payloads, errors, telemetry or LLM messages?
When a withdrawal is pending, does the UI label it PENDING rather than COMPLETE?
Which backlog features already exist on main versus only on PR #7/#8?
What is the smallest independently shippable vertical slice?
Can one rejected risk policy or failed test prevent real-money unlock?
Is a green CI pipeline hiding skipped, unrun, or network-dependent checks?
Can the team restore its backup and prove ledger/audit integrity?
What would convince an independent auditor that this system is not ready yet?
What provider accounts, licenses and hosting services must the owner personally authorize?
